fix(web): resolve device approval race conditions in React StrictMode

Move pending auth state (pendingCipherboxJwt, pendingAuthMethod) from
useState in useAuth to Zustand store so it's shared across hook instances.
Add generation counter to useDeviceApproval to prevent stale requestApproval
completions from overwriting active ephemeral keys. Use stable refs for
requestApproval/cancelRequest in DeviceWaitingScreen to prevent effect
re-fires on upstream dependency cascades. Track handled request IDs to
filter stale polling responses after approve/deny.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
